title: SensorPacket
description: One NDJSON line emitted by the relay box firmware over USB serial, and the row shape stored in collector SQLite / synced to Supabase.

sensor_type.description: Extend this enum rather than repurposing an existing value.

unit.description: Always explicit, e.g. degC, kPa, %RH, ppm, ug/m3. Never inferred from sensor_type.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC, set by the relay box.

seq.description: Monotonic per-node uint32 sequence number, used to detect dropped packets.

crc16.description: Hex CRC16 over the other fields in a fixed field order, computed identically by firmware and collector.
